summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (plus private _resolve_path helper), exported it explicitly from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Line lengths were measured to be within 120 columns. Nothing was run: tests, black, and flake8 were not executed, so behavior and formatting are unverified. Nothing was committed.
